entities.name: Tadeusz Wróblewski
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Tadeusz Stanisław Wróblewski was a Polish noble, politician, lawyer, bibliophile and cultural activist. He supported the democratic wing of the Krajowcy movement and founded the Wróblewski Library in Vilnius.
